extraction.Name: Lucy Little Bear
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, on account of not wishing to pay taxes, but she was told that she would have to take it, and pay taxes, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it about 1924, for the sum of $480.00
extraction.Buyer: Mr. Thadeus Slider, of Dewey, South Dakota
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was informed that there were taxes against her quarter, but she was not sure about that, so that she was scared into selling it for this figure, and at this time, though personally she did not want to sell it
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her five minor children are supported by her husband, who makes a livelihood by common labor
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is not good, suffering from goiter and stomach trouble; has five minor children; they have a hard time in getting along; has never received any help from the County or Government; allotment is NE¼, Sec. 23, T.36 N.R. 48 W; document sworn November 16, 1928
